title: Live probe orchestrator and annotated snapshot pack for guided mitigations
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context and motivation: On high-severity incidents responders often need to run small, targeted probes (health checks, query samples, memory snapshots) across multiple services to validate hypotheses. Existing 'one-shot' diagnostics are ad-hoc and hard to correlate with runbooks. This PR adds a lightweight live probe orchestrator that executes short-lived probes in a safe sandbox, captures annotated snapshots (logs, traces, minimal heap/stack hints where permitted), and packages them into a replayable 'snapshot pack' linked to incident runbooks. The feature also adds a compact UI panel in incident-bot so responders can trigger predefined probe sequences and see suggested guided mitigations based on probe results.

What this PR does (overview): - Implements a probe orchestration engine with safe execution policies, timeouts, and permission gating. - Adds an annotated snapshot pack format (JSONL + attachments manifest) that can be attached to incidents for later replay and postmortem. - Provides a small incident-bot UI panel to run probe sequences, visualize results, and surface remediation suggestions from runbook metadata. - Adds test coverage for orchestration logic and end-to-end smoke tests for probe execution and capture. - Adds docs and a playbook template for teams to define safe probe sets for services.

Design notes and safety: - Probes run in a preconfigured sandbox with network egress restrictions and resource/time caps. - Only on-call roles with the 'probe:execute' permission can run destructive probes; defaults use read-only checks. - Snapshot packs redact secrets and truncate large payloads by policy; a sampling policy controls trace/stack capture to limit PII exposure. - The orchestrator supports dry-run mode which simulates actions without side effects for training/oncall drills.

Checklist: - [x] Orchestrator core implementation - [x] Snapshot pack schema and serializer - [x] UI panel and minimal UX flows - [x] Permission gating and dry-run support - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Docs: docs/oncall/probe-playbook.md - [x] Labeling: incident-bot, sre, telemetry

Priya Nair (reviewer): Tests look solid. One request: the UI shows raw error traces in the panel — can we redact stack frames that match internal secrets or paths?
